_help: Your own church directory, shown with a 'Listed' badge in the church finder at /churches/ alongside OpenStreetMap results.
Fields: name (required), address (required unless lat and lng are given), city, country, denomination, website, phone, serviceTimes, notes, lat, lng, enabled (false hides it).
Addresses are located automatically at build time (OpenStreetMap geocoding) and the result is cached. Give lat/lng directly for precision.
Manage this list from gloriousanchor.com/admin/ under Churches.

churches.name: Faith Tabernacle, Canaanland (Winners' Chapel headquarters)
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 6:00, 8:10 and 10:20 am; Wednesday Midweek Communion Service 5:00 pm
churches.notes: Bishop David O. Oyedepo, presiding bishop. The 50,000-seat Faith Tabernacle, opened 1999, is the headquarters of Winners' Chapel; the Ark, a 109,000-seat church, is being built beside it.

churches.name: Living Faith Church (Winners' Chapel), Sapele Road, Benin City
churches.address: Km 6, Benin-Sapele Road, after Agip Junction, Oka
churches.notes: One of Winners' Chapel's largest provincial churches, and the church where Glorious Anchor's founders met in the Evangelism Unit.

churches.name: Dunamis International Gospel Centre, The Glory Dome
churches.address: The Glory Dome, Lord's Garden, Airport Road
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 6:30 and 9:00 am; Tuesday Healing and Deliverance Service 9:30 am; Wednesday Power Communion Service 5:30 pm; last Friday of the month Worship, Word and Wonders Night 9:30 pm
churches.notes: Dr Paul and Dr Becky Enenche, senior pastors. The 100,000-seat Glory Dome, dedicated in November 2018, is the largest church auditorium in the world.

churches.name: Koinonia Global (Eternity Network International), Abuja
churches.address: Chida Event Centre, Plot 224 Solomon Lar Way, Utako District
churches.notes: Apostle Joshua Selman Nimmak. The weekly Koinonia Abuja service draws crowds that queue from the morning; the new Koinonia Global Arena at Jabi hosts the annual General Assembly.

churches.name: Redeemed Christian Church of God, Redemption City (Redemption Camp)
churches.serviceTimes: Holy Ghost Service: first Friday of every month, 7:00 pm
churches.notes: Pastor E. A. Adeboye, General Overseer. The camp, renamed Redemption City of God in 2022, is a town in its own right with a three-kilometre auditorium, and hosts the monthly Holy Ghost Service and the Holy Ghost Congress each December.

churches.name: RCCG National Headquarters (Throne of Grace), Ebute-Metta
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 7:00 and 10:00 am; Monday Digging Deep 6:00 pm; Tuesday Deliverance and Breakthrough 9:00 am; Thursday Faith Clinic 6:00 pm
churches.notes: The mother church of the RCCG, where Pa Josiah Akindayomi founded the mission in 1952.

churches.name: Salvation Ministries (Home of Success) headquarters
churches.notes: Pastor David Ibiyeomie, founder and senior pastor since 1997. Known for its packed multiple Sunday services and the 5 Nights of Glory crusade.

churches.name: Christ Embassy (LoveWorld), LoveWorld Convocation Arena
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 7:00, 8:45, 10:30 am and 12:00 noon; Wednesday 6:00 pm
churches.notes: Pastor Chris Oyakhilome, founder and president. The 20,000-seat arena is the home of the Lagos Virtual Zone, LoveWorld TV and Rhapsody of Realities.

churches.name: House on the Rock, The Rock Cathedral
churches.address: Rock Cathedral Drive, off Kusenla Road, Ikate-Elegushi, Lekki
churches.notes: Pastor Paul and Pastor Ifeanyi Adefarasin. Global headquarters of House on the Rock and home of The Experience, Africa's largest gospel concert.

churches.name: Daystar Christian Centre
churches.address: Plot A3C Ikosi Road, Oregun, Ikeja
churches.notes: Pastor Sam Adeyemi, founder and senior pastor since 1995. Known for leadership teaching and the Daystar Leadership Academy.

churches.name: Streams of Joy International (NSPPD), Abuja
churches.address: M & M Event Centre, 11 Tafawa Balewa Road, Garki 1, beside Nicon Luxury Hotel
churches.notes: Pastor Jerry Eze, founder and lead pastor, host of NSPPD, the daily 7 am online prayer broadcast. The founding church is Streams of Joy Umuahia, Jubilee House, Km 4 Ikot Ekpene Road (Sunday 7:00, 8:05, 9:15 and 10:45 am).

churches.name: Omega Fire Ministries International headquarters, The Restoration City
churches.serviceTimes: Fire Miracle Night: last Friday of every month; see website for Sunday times
churches.notes: Apostle Johnson Suleman, founder and general overseer since 2004. The Restoration City campus houses Omega Bible University.

churches.name: Deeper Life Bible Church International headquarters, Gbagada
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday Worship Service 8:00 am; Monday Bible Study 6:00 pm
churches.notes: Pastor W. F. Kumuyi, founder and general superintendent since 1973. The 30,000-seat headquarters church was commissioned in April 2018.

churches.name: Christ Apostolic Church, Ebute-Elefun (CAC mother church, Lagos)
churches.serviceTimes: See website; Breaking Barrier Service on the last Sunday of the month
churches.notes: The mother church of the Christ Apostolic Church in Lagos and seat of CAC Lagos DCC.

churches.name: Commonwealth of Zion Assembly (COZA), Guzape
churches.address: 1 Nasir El Rufai Crescent, Guzape Hills, Asokoro Extension
churches.notes: Pastor Biodun and Pastor Modele Fatoyinbo. Known for its youthful services and the 12 Days of Glory and 7DG conferences.

churches.name: Kingsway International Christian Centre (KICC), Prayer City
churches.address: Buckmore Park, Maidstone Road, Chatham, Kent ME5 9QG
churches.notes: Pastor Matthew Ashimolowo, founder and senior pastor since 1992; one of the largest churches in Britain, with a free shuttle from Chatham, Gillingham and Maidstone East stations. London campus: Land of Wonders, 468-474 Hoe Street, Walthamstow E17 9AH.

churches.name: Winners' Chapel International, Dartford (UK and European headquarters)
churches.address: 1 Churchill Close, Green Street Green Road, Dartford, Kent DA1 1QE
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 7:00, 9:15 and 11:30 am; Wednesday 6:00 pm; Covenant Hour of Prayer Monday to Friday 6:00 am
churches.notes: European headquarters of Bishop David Oyedepo's Winners' Chapel, run by World Mission Agency; services last ninety minutes.

churches.name: Lakewood Church
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 8:30 and 11:00 am; Spanish service Sunday 2:00 pm
churches.notes: Joel and Victoria Osteen. The largest congregation in America, meeting in the former Compaq Center.

churches.name: The Potter's House of Dallas
churches.notes: Founded by Bishop T. D. Jakes; led since April 2025 by Sarah Jakes Roberts and Touré Roberts. Known for MegaFest and the Potter's House podcast on GAIN Radio.

churches.name: Elevation Church, Ballantyne
churches.notes: Steven Furtick, lead pastor; home of Elevation Worship.

churches.name: Transformation Church
churches.notes: Michael and Natalie Todd, lead pastors since 2015; known for the Relationship Goals and Crazy Faith series.

churches.name: Bethel Church, Redding
churches.notes: Bill Johnson, senior leader, and Kris Vallotton; home of Bethel Music and the Bethel School of Supernatural Ministry.

churches.name: Harvest Christian Fellowship
churches.denomination: Independent (Calvary Chapel and Southern Baptist affiliated)
churches.notes: Greg Laurie, senior pastor; home of the Harvest Crusades and A New Beginning.

churches.name: Free Chapel, Gainesville
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 9:00 and 11:00 am; Wednesday 7:00 pm online
churches.notes: Jentezen Franklin, senior pastor; known for Kingdom Connection and his teaching on fasting.

churches.name: Oak Cliff Bible Fellowship
churches.notes: Founded by Dr Tony Evans, senior pastor 1976 to 2024; Jonathan Evans, lead pastor. Home of The Urban Alternative.

churches.name: Shadow Mountain Community Church
churches.notes: Dr David Jeremiah, senior pastor; home of Turning Point.

churches.name: First Baptist Church Atlanta
churches.notes: Dr Anthony George, senior pastor, who succeeded Charles Stanley; home church of In Touch Ministries.

churches.name: Jesus Image Church
churches.notes: Michael and Jessica Koulianos; known for extended worship, Jesus School and the Jesus conferences. A permanent home is being built in Sanford, Florida.

churches.name: Cornerstone Church, San Antonio
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 8:30 and 11:00 am; Spanish service Sunday 2:00 pm
churches.notes: John Hagee, founder, and Matt Hagee, lead pastor; home of Hagee Ministries and Christians United for Israel.

churches.name: Times Square Church
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 10:00 am and 1:00 pm; Tuesday and Wednesday 7:00 pm
churches.notes: Founded by David Wilkerson in 1987; Tim Dilena, senior pastor, and Carter Conlon, general overseer. Meets in the Mark Hellinger Theatre.

churches.name: The Brooklyn Tabernacle
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 9:00 am and 12:00 noon; Spanish service Sunday 3:00 pm; prayer meeting Tuesday 6:30 pm
churches.notes: Jim Cymbala, senior pastor; home of the Brooklyn Tabernacle Choir and the Tuesday prayer meeting.

churches.name: Dream City Church, Phoenix
churches.notes: Luke Barnett, senior pastor, and Tommy Barnett, global pastor; founded 1923 as Phoenix First Assembly, home of the Dream Center movement.

churches.name: Gateway Church, Southlake
churches.notes: Daniel Floyd, senior pastor since August 2025; known for Gateway Worship.

churches.name: Church of the Highlands, Grants Mill
churches.notes: Chris Hodges, founding senior pastor; one of the largest churches in America, known for small groups, Highlands College and the ARC church-planting network.

churches.name: Life.Church, Edmond
churches.notes: Craig Groeschel, founder and senior pastor; the church behind the YouVersion Bible App and Church Online.

churches.name: Hillsong Church, Sydney Hills
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 8:00 am, 10:00 am and 6:00 pm; Chinese service 10:15 am
churches.notes: Phil and Lucinda Dooley, global senior pastors; the founding campus, home of Hillsong Worship and Hillsong UNITED.

churches.name: New Creation Church, Singapore
churches.address: The Star Performing Arts Centre, 1 Vista Exchange Green
churches.notes: Joseph Prince, senior pastor; one of Asia's largest churches, known for its grace-centred teaching.

churches.name: Jesus House London (RCCG)
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday Fresh Fire 9:00 am, main service 10:00 am; Monday Bible study 7:00 pm
churches.notes: Pastor Agu Irukwu; the flagship RCCG parish in Britain, at Brent Cross.

churches.name: Hillsong Church UK, Central London
churches.notes: Tim and Nicola Douglass, lead pastors of Hillsong UK; meets in a West End theatre.

churches.name: Yoido Full Gospel Church
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday 7:00, 9:00, 11:00 am and 1:00 pm; English services Sunday 9:00 and 11:00 am
churches.notes: Rev. Lee Young-hoon, senior pastor; founded in 1958 by David Yonggi Cho and long cited as the largest congregation in the world, known for cell groups and Prayer Mountain.

churches.name: Christ Church Jerusalem
churches.address: Omar Ibn Al-Khattab Square, Jaffa Gate, Old City
churches.serviceTimes: Sunday Holy Communion 9:30 am and evening worship 6:00 pm; Saturday Hebrew worship 10:30 am; Wednesday Eucharist 10:30 am
churches.notes: Rev. David Pileggi, rector; the oldest Protestant church in the Middle East, consecrated in 1849, with a guesthouse and heritage centre inside Jaffa Gate.
